lessons.title: Sales & Customer Service
lessons.description: Vocabulary for prospecting, managing accounts, and resolving customer needs.
lessons.tip: Listen for the customer’s need and the proposed next step; sales dialogues often test both.

words.meaning: A potential customer who may buy a product or service.
words.example: The sales team invited three prospects to a product demonstration.

words.meaning: A person or organization identified as a possible buyer.
words.example: Mina assigned the new lead to the representative covering the region.

words.meaning: A sales target assigned for a specific period.
words.example: The regional office exceeded its quarterly sales quota.

words.meaning: Payment calculated as a percentage of sales made.
words.example: Her commission increased after she renewed several large accounts.

words.meaning: Income a business receives from its activities.
words.example: Online orders now account for a third of the company’s revenue.

words.meaning: To discuss terms in order to reach an agreement.
words.example: The account manager negotiated a lower rate for a two-year contract.

words.meaning: A formal statement of the price for specified goods or work.
words.example: Please send the client a quotation for 500 replacement units.

words.meaning: A partial refund offered after a customer has made a purchase.
words.example: The manufacturer offered a rebate to businesses that ordered the energy-efficient printers.
words.tip: A rebate is returned after purchase, unlike an immediate price reduction.

words.meaning: A geographic area or customer group assigned to a sales representative.
words.vietnameseMeaning: khu vực phụ trách kinh doanh
words.example: Nora took over the sales territory after the branch added two new counties.
words.tip: A territory defines a representative’s coverage, not an individual customer record.

words.meaning: A person or organization that receives professional services.
words.example: The agency revised the campaign after meeting with its client.

words.meaning: To keep a customer or employee rather than lose them.
words.example: Personalized support helped the firm retain several major customers.

words.meaning: The act of extending an agreement or subscription.
words.example: We sent a renewal notice sixty days before the service expired.

words.meaning: A statement that a product or service is unsatisfactory.
words.example: The supervisor reviewed a complaint about a delayed installation.

words.meaning: To find an acceptable solution to a problem.
words.example: Support resolved the billing issue before the customer’s next call.

words.meaning: Money returned to a customer for a purchase.
words.example: The customer received a full refund when the shipment arrived damaged.

words.meaning: A written promise to repair or replace a product within a period.
words.example: The printer is still covered by a two-year warranty.

words.meaning: A request for information.
words.example: A staff member answered an inquiry about bulk pricing.

words.meaning: A person who speaks or acts for a company or group.
words.example: A customer service representative called to confirm the delivery window.

words.meaning: The state of being pleased with a product or service.
words.example: The quarterly survey measures customer satisfaction after each repair.

words.meaning: A customer’s continued preference for a business or brand.
words.example: The loyalty program rewards customers who place repeat orders.

words.meaning: An arrangement to receive a service or publication regularly.
words.example: The customer changed her subscription to an annual plan.

words.meaning: A formal request for help, information, or action from a service provider.
words.example: The representative logged a service request after the client reported intermittent access.
words.tip: In customer-service conversations, listen for what action the request requires.

words.meaning: To persuade a buyer to choose a more expensive option.
words.example: The representative offered to upsell the customer to a plan with more storage.

words.meaning: To offer a customer a related additional product.
words.example: The adviser cross-sold a maintenance plan with the equipment order.

words.meaning: A persuasive presentation intended to encourage a purchase.
words.example: Her sales pitch focused on the software’s time-saving features.

words.meaning: Further contact made after an earlier conversation or action.
words.example: The representative scheduled a follow-up after the customer tested the sample.

words.meaning: The process of turning a prospect into a paying customer.
words.vietnameseMeaning: sự chuyển đổi thành khách hàng
words.example: The team tracks conversion from product demonstration to paid order.

words.meaning: An estimate of sales expected during a future period.
words.example: The sales forecast was revised after two large clients postponed their orders.
words.tip: A forecast estimates likely results; a quota is an assigned goal.

words.meaning: Comments or information used to evaluate a product or service.
words.example: Product development used customer feedback to simplify the setup process.

words.meaning: Polite behavior that shows respect and consideration.
words.example: Even during a busy shift, the staff treated every caller with courtesy.

lessons.title: Travel & Transportation
lessons.description: Terms for business trips, passenger services, and moving people or goods.
lessons.tip: Separate scheduled travel details from disruptions such as delays or cancellations.

words.meaning: A plan listing the route and schedule of a trip.
words.example: The assistant emailed the revised itinerary to everyone attending the trade fair.

words.meaning: The act or scheduled time of leaving a place.
words.example: Passengers should reach the platform ten minutes before departure.

words.meaning: The act or scheduled time of reaching a destination.
words.example: Upon arrival, visiting engineers should collect their badges at reception.

words.meaning: A period spent waiting between connecting parts of a trip.
words.example: A four-hour layover gave the consultant time to join a video meeting.

words.meaning: A subsequent flight, train, or service taken during a journey.
words.example: The agent found a later connection after the first flight was delayed.

words.meaning: A document or digital pass that permits a passenger to board.
words.example: Keep the boarding pass ready when the gate agent calls your group.

words.meaning: The process of registering for a flight, hotel, or event.
words.example: Online check-in opens twenty-four hours before the flight.

words.meaning: The bags and cases a traveler takes on a journey.
words.example: The airline delivered the delayed baggage to the office hotel that evening.

words.meaning: A small bag a passenger is allowed to take into a vehicle cabin.
words.example: Her carry-on contained the presentation materials and laptop.

words.meaning: The price paid for a journey by public transportation.
words.example: The quoted fare includes the airport shuttle and local taxes.

words.meaning: An arrangement to secure a seat or place in advance.
words.example: I confirmed the rail reservation before submitting the expense report.

words.meaning: A building or area where passengers begin or end a journey.
words.vietnameseMeaning: nhà ga; nhà ga sân bay
words.example: The conference shuttle leaves from the north terminal every half hour.

words.meaning: A designated airport area where passengers board an aircraft.
words.example: The departure gate changed, so the group checked the flight display again.

words.meaning: A raised area where passengers board or leave a train.
words.example: Commuters waited on platform three while crews inspected the track.

words.meaning: To travel regularly between home and work.
words.example: Several employees commute by train to avoid downtown traffic.

words.meaning: A vehicle that makes regular trips between nearby places.
words.example: A complimentary shuttle runs between the plant and the station.

words.meaning: The movement of people or goods from one place to another.
words.example: The package remained in transit overnight at the regional hub.

words.meaning: A situation in which something happens later than planned.
words.example: A weather delay pushed the team’s arrival back by two hours.

words.meaning: The act of stopping a planned event or service.
words.example: The carrier notified passengers of the cancellation by text message.

words.meaning: To direct a person or vehicle along a different route.
words.example: Dispatch rerouted the delivery vans around the closed bridge.

words.meaning: A vehicle or other item hired for temporary use.
words.example: The rental was ready at the counter when the sales team landed.

words.meaning: The distance traveled, or distance a vehicle can cover per unit of fuel.
words.vietnameseMeaning: quãng đường; mức tiêu hao nhiên liệu
words.example: Employees record business mileage in the travel portal each month.

words.meaning: A fee charged for using a particular road or bridge.
words.example: The driver kept the toll receipt with the other trip expenses.

words.meaning: Vehicles moving along roads, especially when the flow is heavy.
words.example: Heavy traffic delayed the courier’s arrival at the distribution center.

words.meaning: A different route used when the usual route is blocked.
words.example: Roadwork required a detour past the industrial park.

words.meaning: A person employed to drive a passenger vehicle.
words.example: The visiting executive requested a chauffeur for meetings across town.

words.meaning: A person traveling in a vehicle but not operating it.
words.example: Each passenger must show identification before boarding the charter bus.

words.meaning: A railway employee who assists passengers and oversees service on a train.
words.vietnameseMeaning: nhân viên phục vụ trên tàu
words.example: The conductor announced that passengers could board the regional train.
words.tip: A conductor works aboard a train; a driver operates a road vehicle.

words.meaning: A display showing scheduled departures and their current status.
words.example: The team checked the departure board after a gate change was announced.
words.tip: A departure board lists service times and updates, not the physical gate itself.

words.meaning: A shipping service that transports a parcel faster than standard delivery.
words.example: The office used express delivery to send signed contracts to the regional branch.
words.tip: Express delivery describes a shipping option rather than the act of assigning a vehicle.

lessons.title: Hotels & Restaurants
lessons.description: Language for lodging, guest services, dining, and event hospitality.
lessons.tip: Hotel notices distinguish included amenities from optional services and additional charges.

words.meaning: A place or arrangement that provides lodging.
words.example: The travel coordinator booked accommodation near the training venue.

words.meaning: A hotel employee who carries guests’ luggage and may assist on arrival.
words.vietnameseMeaning: nhân viên khuân hành lý khách sạn
words.example: The porter took the visiting auditors’ cases to their rooms.
words.tip: A porter assists guests with luggage; a concierge arranges local services.

words.meaning: The number or proportion of rooms being used.
words.example: The hotel’s occupancy rose during the annual industry conference.

words.meaning: A hotel employee who assists guests with local services and arrangements.
words.example: The concierge arranged a taxi for the visiting sales director.

words.meaning: The hotel reception area where guests receive assistance.
words.example: Please leave the signed delivery form at the front desk.

words.meaning: The department responsible for cleaning and maintaining guest rooms.
words.example: Housekeeping prepared the meeting suite before the delegation arrived.

words.meaning: A feature or service that makes a place more comfortable or useful.
words.example: Reliable Wi-Fi is an essential amenity for business travelers.

words.meaning: A set of connected rooms used as one unit, often in a hotel.
words.example: The organizer reserved a suite where the interview panel could meet privately.

words.meaning: The price charged for a hotel room for a specified period.
words.example: The quoted room rate included Wi-Fi but not breakfast.

words.meaning: A card used electronically to unlock a hotel room.
words.example: The receptionist encoded a key card for each guest attending the workshop.

words.meaning: The process of leaving a hotel and settling the account.
words.example: Express check-out let the project team leave before the morning session.

words.meaning: A statement or message showing that an arrangement is secured.
words.example: The manager saved the room confirmation with the conference documents.

words.meaning: Fabric items such as sheets and towels used in guest rooms.
words.example: Housekeeping replaced the room linen before the conference delegates checked in.
words.tip: In hospitality, linen commonly refers to sheets, pillowcases, and towels.

words.meaning: An additional charge added to the usual price.
words.example: A late checkout surcharge applies after the stated departure time.

words.meaning: Provided free of charge as a courtesy.
words.example: The hotel offers complimentary coffee in the lobby before the morning seminar.

words.meaning: A meal where diners serve themselves from a selection of dishes.
words.example: The conference buffet included vegetarian options and labeled allergens.

words.meaning: A list of food and drinks available at a restaurant.
words.example: The event planner reviewed the menu with the chef before confirming the banquet.

words.meaning: The main dish of a meal.
words.example: The hotel restaurant added a fish entrée to its business lunch menu.

words.meaning: A small dish served before the main course.
words.example: The server brought an appetizer while the clients reviewed the proposal.

words.meaning: A drink, especially one served with a meal.
words.example: The catering order includes one beverage for each workshop participant.

words.meaning: Relating to the food a person can or chooses to eat.
words.example: The registration form asks guests to report any dietary requirements.

words.meaning: A substance that can cause an allergic reaction.
words.example: The kitchen marked each allergen on the meal cards for the seminar.

words.meaning: A statement of the amount owed for a meal or service.
words.example: The restaurant sent an itemized bill to the company’s accounts team.

words.meaning: A voluntary payment given for service, often called a tip.
words.example: The group asked whether gratuity was already included in the dinner charge.

words.meaning: A fee added to a bill for service.
words.example: A ten-percent service charge appears separately on the banquet invoice.

words.meaning: The business of providing food and drink for an event.
words.example: Catering delivered boxed lunches to the training rooms at noon.

words.meaning: A formal or large meal prepared for a group or celebration.
words.example: The hotel hosted a banquet for delegates attending the trade association meeting.

words.meaning: A hotel service that delivers food or drink to a guest’s room.
words.vietnameseMeaning: dịch vụ phục vụ tại phòng
words.example: The consultant ordered room service while finishing a report after the client meeting.

words.meaning: A hotel employee responsible for cleaning and preparing guest rooms.
words.example: The room attendant replenished the towels before the guests returned from the seminar.
words.tip: A room attendant maintains guest rooms; front-desk staff handle check-in and payment.

words.meaning: The practices and conditions that protect public health and cleanliness.
words.vietnameseMeaning: vệ sinh; điều kiện vệ sinh
words.example: The inspector reviewed kitchen sanitation before renewing the restaurant permit.

lessons.title: Shopping & Retail
lessons.description: Useful terms for product selection, store operations, and customer purchases.
lessons.tip: Identify whether a retail problem concerns the item, its price, or the transaction.

words.meaning: Goods offered for sale in a store or by a business.
words.example: The manager moved seasonal merchandise to the front of the store.

words.meaning: The goods a business has available for sale or use.
words.vietnameseMeaning: hàng tồn kho; hàng dự trữ
words.example: Staff counted the inventory before the new catalog went to print.

words.meaning: A room where a store keeps goods before displaying or selling them.
words.example: A clerk checked the stockroom for the requested jacket size.

words.meaning: A printed pattern that stores data and can be scanned.
words.example: The cashier rescanned the barcode after the first reading failed.

words.meaning: The place or process where a customer pays for purchases.
words.vietnameseMeaning: quầy thanh toán; thủ tục thanh toán
words.example: The store added another checkout during the lunchtime rush.

words.meaning: A person who receives customer payments in a store.
words.example: The cashier explained how to apply the store credit to the purchase.

words.meaning: A machine or system used to record sales and take payment.
words.example: The supervisor rebooted the register before opening the second lane.

words.meaning: A record showing what was purchased and how much was paid.
words.example: A customer presented the receipt to exchange a defective kettle.

words.meaning: The act of replacing a purchased item with another one.
words.example: The exchange was approved because the unopened item was the wrong model.

words.meaning: An item brought back to a seller, usually for a refund or replacement.
words.example: Returns must be processed at the service counter within thirty days.

words.meaning: A sale of goods at reduced prices to remove remaining stock.
words.example: The display furniture was marked for clearance to make room for new designs.

words.meaning: A reduction in the selling price of an item.
words.example: The buyer approved a markdown on last season’s coats.

words.meaning: The amount added to a product’s cost to set its selling price.
words.example: The retailer adjusted its markup after reviewing shipping costs.

words.meaning: A passage between rows of shelves or seats.
words.example: A sign directed shoppers to the aisle containing office supplies.

words.meaning: A flat surface used to display or store goods.
words.example: The supplier restocked the top shelf before the store opened.

words.meaning: An arrangement of goods designed to attract attention.
words.example: A seasonal display near the entrance highlighted the new collection.

words.meaning: A room where customers try on clothes before buying them.
words.example: The attendant brought a different size to the fitting room.

words.meaning: Something bought, or the act of buying it.
words.vietnameseMeaning: món hàng đã mua; việc mua
words.example: The online purchase qualified for free delivery to the branch office.

words.meaning: A card that identifies a member and records purchases for a rewards program.
words.example: At checkout, the associate scanned the customer’s loyalty card to apply earned points.
words.tip: A loyalty card tracks membership benefits; it is not the payment transaction itself.

words.meaning: A virtual basket where an online shopper collects items before checkout.
words.example: The customer saved the selected office chairs in a shopping cart before requesting a quote.
words.tip: On retail websites, the shopping cart holds selected products before purchase.

words.meaning: A person or company that sells goods or services.
words.example: The store selected a local vendor to supply reusable shopping bags.

words.meaning: A business that provides goods or materials to another business.
words.example: The supplier confirmed that the display units would arrive by Tuesday.

words.meaning: An order for an item that is temporarily unavailable but expected later.
words.example: The customer accepted a backorder for the popular desk lamp.

words.meaning: Unavailable for purchase because no units remain.
words.example: The requested color was out of stock at the downtown branch.

words.meaning: A label showing the cost of an item for sale.
words.example: An employee replaced the missing price tag before the store opened.

words.meaning: An item or service made or offered for sale.
words.example: The retailer tested the new product in three city locations.

words.meaning: A proof-of-purchase receipt that omits prices and can accompany a gift.
words.example: The sales associate included a gift receipt so the recipient could exchange the sweater.
words.tip: A gift receipt usually allows an exchange without showing the purchaser’s price.

words.meaning: Decorative paper or other material used to cover a gift.
words.example: The customer asked the cashier whether gift wrap was available for the presentation set.
words.tip: Retailers may offer gift wrap as an optional service at checkout.

words.meaning: Applying to or available throughout an entire store.
words.vietnameseMeaning: áp dụng trên toàn cửa hàng
words.example: A storewide price reduction begins after the inventory count.

words.meaning: A request for repair or replacement under a product guarantee.
words.example: Customer service filed a warranty claim for the faulty coffee machine.

lessons.title: Technology & Computers
lessons.description: Computer and software vocabulary for office work, troubleshooting, and digital collaboration.
lessons.tip: For technical problems, note the affected device, the error, and the troubleshooting step already taken.

words.meaning: Programs and operating instructions used by a computer.
words.example: The accounting software generates a monthly expense summary.

words.meaning: The physical equipment and components of a computer system.
words.example: IT replaced the damaged hardware before the design review.

words.meaning: A computer and desk setup used by one person, often for specialized work.
words.example: The new analyst received a workstation with two monitors.

words.meaning: A connected group of computers that can share information and resources.
words.example: The office network was unavailable during the scheduled maintenance.

words.meaning: A computer or program that provides data or services to other computers.
words.example: The server stores project files for teams in both offices.

words.meaning: An organized collection of information stored for easy access and management.
words.example: The sales database was updated with the latest customer contacts.

words.meaning: A digital document that organizes data in rows and columns.
words.example: Finance shared a spreadsheet showing the revised travel budget.

words.meaning: A file sent along with an email or other digital message.
words.example: The vendor’s email included an attachment with the product specifications.

words.meaning: To copy data from a remote system onto a local device.
words.example: Employees can download the updated handbook from the staff portal.

words.meaning: To transfer data from a local device to a remote system.
words.example: Please upload the signed form before the application deadline.

words.meaning: To set up software or equipment so it is ready to use.
words.example: Technicians will install the security update after business hours.

words.meaning: A newer version or the act of making something more current.
words.vietnameseMeaning: bản cập nhật; việc cập nhật
words.example: The latest update fixes an issue with calendar invitations.

words.meaning: To replace or improve a system with a newer or better version.
words.example: The company plans to upgrade its video-conferencing equipment.

words.meaning: A copy of data kept in case the original is lost or damaged.
words.example: Nightly backup protects the department’s shared project files.

words.meaning: To return data or a system to an earlier working state.
words.example: IT restored the deleted folder from yesterday’s backup.

words.meaning: A secret series of characters used to verify a user’s identity.
words.example: Staff must create a unique password for the new expense platform.

words.meaning: The act or credentials used to access a computer system.
words.vietnameseMeaning: đăng nhập; thông tin đăng nhập
words.example: Her login stopped working after the account security review.

words.meaning: The ability or permission to enter or use a system or information.
words.example: Only project leads have access to the confidential folder.

words.meaning: A program used to view and interact with websites.
words.example: The training portal works best in an up-to-date browser.

words.meaning: The capacity of a network connection to transfer data.
words.example: Video calls used less bandwidth after the team disabled high-definition mode.

words.meaning: A period when a service or system is unavailable.
words.example: A brief network outage interrupted the morning webinar.

words.meaning: To identify and solve problems with equipment or software.
words.example: A technician helped the branch troubleshoot its scanner connection.

words.meaning: Able to work or be used together without problems.
words.example: Check that the new headset is compatible with the office phone system.

words.meaning: A piece of electronic equipment made for a particular purpose.
words.example: The mobile device must be registered before it can access company email.

words.meaning: A set of keys used to enter text or commands into a computer.
words.example: The support desk replaced the keyboard after several keys stopped responding.

words.meaning: A screen used to display information from a computer.
words.example: The designer connected a second monitor for reviewing large drawings.

words.meaning: A machine that produces paper copies of digital documents.
words.example: The printer near reception ran out of toner before the meeting.

words.meaning: A device connected to a computer that adds a specific function.
words.example: The technician tested each peripheral before returning the workstation.

words.meaning: The process of converting data into a form that prevents unauthorized reading.
words.example: Encryption protects confidential files sent to the remote office.

words.meaning: Online storage that keeps files on remote servers for internet access.
words.example: The team moved shared documents to cloud storage for easier collaboration.
